questions.question: Spring Boot là gì và tại sao phổ biến hơn Spring Framework thuần?

options.A: Spring Boot thay thế hoàn toàn Java
options.B: Spring Boot: opinionated auto-configuration, embedded server (Tomcat), starter dependencies — không cần XML config, chạy được ngay
options.D: Spring Boot và Spring Framework giống nhau

questions.explanation: Spring Framework: powerful nhưng cần nhiều config (XML hoặc Java-based). Spring Boot: (1) Auto-configuration: scan classpath, cấu hình beans tự động. (2) Starters: spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa — gộp dependencies liên quan. (3) Embedded Tomcat/Jetty: đóng gói vào JAR, java -jar app.jar. (4) Actuator: health, metrics endpoints. (5) Spring Initializr: generate project structure. Convention over configuration.

questions.question: Dependency Injection (DI) và IoC Container trong Spring?

options.B: IoC Container quản lý bean lifecycle. DI: @Autowired/@RequiredArgsConstructor inject dependencies tự động. Constructor injection được recommend
options.D: Spring chỉ hỗ trợ singleton beans

questions.explanation: IoC (Inversion of Control): framework quản lý objects thay vì code. Spring ApplicationContext = IoC container. Bean: object managed bởi Spring. DI types: (1) Constructor injection (recommended — immutable, testable). (2) Setter injection. (3) Field injection (@Autowired trực tiếp — khó test). @Component, @Service, @Repository, @Controller: stereotype annotations, auto-detected. @Bean trong @Configuration: explicit bean definition. @Qualifier: khi có nhiều implementations.

questions.question: Spring Boot REST API — @RestController, @GetMapping, @RequestBody?

options.A: Spring Boot không hỗ trợ REST
options.B: @RestController = @Controller + @ResponseBody. @GetMapping/@PostMapping cho routes. @RequestBody deserialize JSON. @PathVariable/@RequestParam cho params
options.D: REST API cần XML config trong Spring

questions.explanation: @RestController: auto serialize return value thành JSON. Mapping annotations: @GetMapping, @PostMapping, @PutMapping, @DeleteMapping, @PatchMapping. @PathVariable: /users/{id}. @RequestParam: /users?page=1. @RequestBody: POST body → Java object (Jackson deserialize). @ResponseStatus: set HTTP status. ResponseEntity<T>: full control over response (status, headers, body). @Valid + BindingResult: request validation. HTTP status codes: 200, 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500.

questions.question: Spring Data JPA — Repository pattern?

options.A: Spring Data JPA thay thế SQL hoàn toàn
options.B: JpaRepository<Entity, ID>: cung cấp CRUD methods sẵn có. Derived queries: findByName(), findByAgeGreaterThan(). @Query cho custom JPQL/SQL
options.C: JPA chỉ dùng được với MySQL
options.D: @Entity không cần thiết với Spring Data

questions.explanation: @Entity: map class to table. @Id + @GeneratedValue: primary key. @Column: column mapping. JpaRepository methods: findById, findAll, save, delete, count. Derived queries: findByEmailAndActive(String email, boolean active) → Spring tự generate query từ method name. @Query('SELECT u FROM User u WHERE u.email = :email'): JPQL. @Query(value='...', nativeQuery=true): native SQL. Pagination: findAll(Pageable pageable). @Transactional: transaction management.

questions.question: Spring Boot application.properties vs application.yml?

options.A: Cả hai giống nhau, chỉ khác syntax
options.B: Cùng chức năng, YAML (yml) dễ đọc hơn với nested config. Profiles: application-dev.yml, application-prod.yml. @Value và @ConfigurationProperties để inject
options.D: YAML không hỗ trợ trong Spring Boot

questions.explanation: application.properties: spring.datasource.url=jdbc:postgresql://localhost/mydb. application.yml: spring: datasource: url: jdbc:postgresql://localhost/mydb. YAML: less repetition, supports lists và maps natively. Profiles: @Profile('dev'), spring.profiles.active=dev. @Value('${spring.datasource.url}'): inject property. @ConfigurationProperties(prefix='app'): bind config class. Override với env vars: SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL. Spring Cloud Config: external config server.

questions.question: Spring Security cơ bản — authentication và authorization?

options.A: Spring Security chỉ cho login form
options.B: SecurityFilterChain: configure HTTP security. UserDetailsService: load user. BCryptPasswordEncoder. JWT filter chain. Method security: @PreAuthorize
options.D: Spring Security không hỗ trợ JWT

questions.explanation: Spring Security filter chain intercepts mọi request. Authentication: verify identity (password, JWT, OAuth2). Authorization: verify permissions. BCryptPasswordEncoder: hash passwords. SecurityFilterChain: .authorizeHttpRequests().requestMatchers('/api/public').permitAll().anyRequest().authenticated(). JWT: OncePerRequestFilter để validate JWT, set SecurityContext. Method security: @EnableMethodSecurity + @PreAuthorize('hasRole("ADMIN")'). OAuth2: spring-boot-starter-oauth2-resource-server, spring-boot-starter-oauth2-client.

questions.question: Spring AOP (Aspect-Oriented Programming) — use cases?

options.B: AOP: cross-cutting concerns (logging, transaction, security, caching, metrics) tách khỏi business logic. @Aspect, @Before, @After, @Around, @Pointcut
options.D: Spring Boot không hỗ trợ AOP

questions.explanation: Cross-cutting concerns = functionality dùng nhiều nơi nhưng không thuộc business logic: logging, transaction management (@Transactional dùng AOP), security (@PreAuthorize), caching (@Cacheable), retry (@Retryable). @Around advice: ProceedingJoinPoint.proceed() để wrap method execution. @Pointcut: define where to apply: execution(* com.example.service.*.*(..)). Spring AOP: proxy-based (JDK dynamic proxy hoặc CGLIB). Limitation: chỉ work với Spring-managed beans, không work với private methods.

questions.question: Spring Boot testing — @SpringBootTest vs @WebMvcTest vs @DataJpaTest?

options.B: @SpringBootTest: full context (integration). @WebMvcTest: chỉ web layer (nhanh hơn). @DataJpaTest: chỉ JPA layer với in-memory DB. MockMvc cho HTTP testing
options.C: Spring Boot không hỗ trợ unit testing

questions.explanation: Test pyramid: Unit > Integration > E2E. @WebMvcTest(UserController.class): chỉ load web layer, mock service layer. MockMvc: mockMvc.perform(get('/users').andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(jsonPath('$.name').value('Alice')). @DataJpaTest: embedded H2 DB, test repositories. @SpringBootTest: full application context, slow nhưng realistic. @MockBean: mock Spring beans. @Testcontainers: real PostgreSQL trong Docker cho tests. TestRestTemplate: integration tests với real HTTP.

questions.question: Spring Boot microservice với service discovery (Eureka/Consul)?

options.B: Eureka Server: service registry. Eureka Client: register và discover services. Feign Client: declarative HTTP client. Load balancing với Spring Cloud LoadBalancer

questions.explanation: Service discovery: services register vào registry (Eureka/Consul) với tên, dynamic IP. Other services discover bằng name thay vì hardcoded IP. Spring Cloud: @EnableEurekaServer, @EnableEurekaClient. Feign: @FeignClient(name='user-service') interface UserServiceClient. Ribbon (deprecated) → Spring Cloud LoadBalancer: client-side load balancing. Circuit Breaker: Resilience4j @CircuitBreaker(name='service', fallbackMethod='fallback'). Config Server: centralized configuration.

questions.question: Spring Boot N+1 query problem với JPA — detect và fix?

options.B: N+1: fetch entity rồi lazy load associations → N queries. Fix: @EntityGraph, JOIN FETCH trong @Query, Hibernate.initialize(), hoặc DTO projection

questions.explanation: N+1 example: orders = orderRepo.findAll() (1 query) → orders.forEach(o -> o.getUser().getName()) (N queries). Fix: (1) @EntityGraph(attributePaths={'user'}): eager load trên query. (2) JOIN FETCH: @Query('SELECT o FROM Order o JOIN FETCH o.user'). (3) Batch size: @BatchSize(size=10) trên association → IN query. (4) DTO projection: interface-based hoặc class-based projection lấy chỉ columns cần. (5) Hibernate statistics: spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.generate_statistics=true → log queries. (6) p6spy hoặc datasource-proxy để log SQL với parameters.

questions.question: Spring Boot app trên K8s bị slow startup (60s). Cách optimize?

options.B: AOT compilation (GraalVM native image), lazy initialization, component scan optimization, Spring Boot 3 CDS (Class Data Sharing)

questions.explanation: Slow startup causes: component scanning, bean initialization, Hibernate schema validation. Optimizations: (1) spring.main.lazy-initialization=true: beans initialized on first request (faster startup, slower first request). (2) GraalVM native image (Spring Boot 3 + Spring Native): compile to native binary, sub-second startup, lower memory. Tradeoff: longer build time. (3) spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=none in production (no schema validation). (4) Spring Boot 3.3+ CDS: Class Data Sharing, cache JVM class loading. (5) Reduce @ComponentScan scope. (6) Profile startup với -Dspring.aot.enabled=true.
